sentences.en: Although we waited until ten o'clock, Bill never showed up.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们等到十点钟，比尔还是没有出现。

sentences.en: Although the web looks soft and delicate, it is strong.
sentences.zh: 虽然网看起来柔软而脆弱，但它很结实。

sentences.en: Although he was wrong, he didn't say he was sorry.
sentences.zh: 尽管他错了，但他并没有道歉。
